type.quote: There is hereby created a Board of Dentistry whose duty it shall be to carry out the purposes and enforce the provisions of sections 150A.01 to 150A.12.

moral_character_required.quote: A person of good moral character who has graduated from a dental program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation

degree_required.value: Graduation from a dental program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation, leading to the D.D.S. or D.M.D. degree
degree_required.quote: graduated from a predoctoral dental education program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation, or another accrediting agency recognized by the United States Department of Education for the accreditation of dentistry and dental hygiene education programs, leading to the Doctor of Dental Surgery (D.D.S.) or Doctor of Dental Medicine (D.M.D.) degree

accrediting_body.quote: graduated from a dental program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation

degree_level.quote: leading to the Doctor of Dental Surgery (D.D.S.) or Doctor of Dental Medicine (D.M.D.) degree

school_approval_basis.quote: graduated from a dental program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation

credential_pegged.quote: A person of good moral character who has graduated from a dental program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation, having submitted an application and fee as prescribed by the board, may be examined by the board

required.quote: A person of good moral character who has graduated from a dental program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation, having submitted an application and fee as prescribed by the board, may be examined by the board or by an agency pursuant to section 150A.03, subdivision 1, in a manner to test the applicant's fitness to practice dentistry.

experience_source.quote: An applicant who passes the examination in compliance with subdivision 2b, abides by professional ethical conduct requirements, and meets all other requirements of the board shall be licensed to practice dentistry and granted a general dentist license by the board.

exams.name: National Board Dental Examinations
exams.notes: All components must be passed; may be waived at board discretion for certain applicants
exams.jurisdiction: national (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.quote: All or any part of the examination for dentists … may, at the discretion of the board, be waived for an applicant who presents a certificate of having passed all components of the National Board Dental Examinations

exams.name: Clinical examination
exams.notes: Applicant ineligible to retake after failing twice until further education and training obtained as specified by board rule
exams.jurisdiction: administered by the board or a board-approved agency
exams.quote: An applicant is ineligible to retake the clinical examination required by the board after failing it twice until further education and training are obtained as specified by the board by rule.

exams.name: Minnesota jurisprudence examination
exams.notes: Examination of applicant's knowledge of Minnesota laws and board rules
exams.quote: The examination shall include an examination of the applicant's knowledge of the laws of Minnesota relating to dentistry and the rules of the board.

interval_years.quote: Pursuant to Minnesota Rules, chapter 3100, and at the discretion of the board, a limited faculty license must be renewed annually and a full faculty license must be renewed biennially.

required.quote: have continuing professional development requirements as a condition for license renewal

available.quote: Any dentist or dental hygienist may, upon application and payment of a fee established by the board, apply for licensure based on the applicant's performance record in lieu of passing an examination approved by the board

requirements.value: Licensure by credentials available for dentists; must have passed all components of National Board Dental Examinations, been in active practice at least 2,000 hours within 36 months of application, currently hold or previously held a license in another state or Canadian province in good standing, be of good moral character, and meet other credentialing requirements. A dentist and dental hygienist compact (interstate compact) also enacted allowing compact privileges.
requirements.quote: Any dentist or dental hygienist may, upon application and payment of a fee established by the board, apply for licensure based on the applicant's performance record in lieu of passing an examination

exists.quote: There is hereby created a Board of Dentistry whose duty it shall be to carry out the purposes and enforce the provisions of sections 150A.01 to 150A.12.

national_certification.value: Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations
national_certification.quote: accept the national board examinations of the joint commission on national dental examinations or another examination accepted by commission rule as a licensure examination

national_association.quote: the Minnesota Dental Association, Minnesota Dental Assistants Association, or the Minnesota Dental Hygienists' Association shall recommend to the governor for each term expiring not less than two dentists

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to: enable an unlicensed person to practice dentistry; to practice or attempt to practice dentistry without a license

is_mandatory.quote: to practice or attempt to practice dentistry without a license

title_protection.quote: If a dentist practices under the dentist's own name, any public display or cards shall include the initials of the dentist's dental degree, such as D.D.S. or D.M.D., following the name.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to: enable an unlicensed person to practice dentistry; to practice or attempt to practice dentistry without a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deception in connection with the practice of dentistry or the securing of a license certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or deception in connection with the practice of dentistry or the securing of a license certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or gross misdemeanor reasonably related to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction, including a finding or verdict of guilt, an admission of guilt, or a no contest plea, in any court of a felony or gross misdemeanor reasonably related to the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of an offense involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction, including a finding or verdict of guilt, an admission of guilt, or a no contest plea, in any court of an offense involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual overindulgence in the use of intoxicating liquors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual overindulgence in the use of intoxicating liquors

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improper or unauthorized prescription, dispensing, administering, or personal use of legend drugs, chemicals, or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: improper or unauthorized prescription, dispensing, administering, or personal or other use of any legend drug as defined in chapter 151, of any chemical as defined in chapter 151, or of any controlled substance as defined in chapter 152

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct unbecoming a licensed person or contrary to the best interest of the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct unbecoming a person licensed to practice dentistry, dental therapy, dental hygiene, or dental assisting, or conduct contrary to the best interest of the public, as such conduct is defined by the rules of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical, mental, emotional, or other disability that adversely affects ability to perform licensed services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any physical, mental, emotional, or other disability which adversely affects a dentist's, dental therapist's, dental hygienist's, or dental assistant's ability to perform the service for which the person is licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action taken by a licensing authority of another state, territory, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revocation or suspension of a license or equivalent authority to practice, or other disciplinary action or denial of a license application taken by a licensing or credentialing authority of another state, territory, or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain adequate safety and sanitary conditions for a dental office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to maintain adequate safety and sanitary conditions for a dental office in accordance with the standards established by the rules of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, assisting, or enabling an unlicensed person to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: employing, assisting, or enabling in any manner an unlicensed person to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to attend, testify, and produce records as directed by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure or refusal to attend, testify, and produce records as directed by the board under subdivision 7

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or failure to comply with provisions of sections 150A.01 to 150A.12, board rules, or any disciplinary order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of, or failure to comply with, any other provisions of sections 150A.01 to 150A.12, the rules of the Board of Dentistry, or any disciplinary order issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly providing false or misleading information directly related to the care of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly providing false or misleading information that is directly related to the care of that patient unless done for an accepted therapeutic purpose such as the administration of a placebo

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding suicide or aiding attempted suicide in violation of section 609.215
disciplinary_grounds.quote: aiding suicide or aiding attempted suicide in violation of section 609.215

establishment_regulation_required.quote: All dental laboratories physically located in Minnesota must register with the Board of Dentistry.

definition_quote.value: A person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry within the meaning of sections 150A.01 to 150A.12 who uses a dental degree, or designation, or card, device, directory, sign, or other media whereby the person represents an ability to diagnose, treat, prescribe, or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums or jaw, or adjacent or associated structures
definition_quote.quote: A person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry within the meaning of sections 150A.01 to 150A.12: (1) who uses a dental degree, or designation, or card, device, directory, sign, or other media whereby the person represents an ability to diagnose, treat, prescribe, or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums or jaw, or adjacent or associated structures

value: diagnosis and treatment of diseases, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaw, or adjacent structures
use of roentgen or x-ray machine for dental treatment or diagnostic purposes
extraction of human teeth; correction of malpositions of teeth or jaws
removing stains or accretions from human teeth or jaws
taking impressions; replacement of parts of teeth by fillings, crowns, bridges, dentures, or other appliances
furnishing, supplying, constructing, reproducing, or repairing prosthetic dentures, bridges, or other substitutes for natural teeth
clinical operations included in curricula of recognized dental schools and colleges
administration of influenza vaccines (with required training)
methods_authorized.quote: who performs dental operations of any kind gratuitously, or for a fee, gift, compensation or reward … who extracts a human tooth or teeth, or corrects or attempts to correct malpositions of the human teeth or jaws … who takes impressions of the human tooth, teeth, or jaws or performs any phase of any operation incident to the replacement of a part of a tooth

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe and administer drugs within their scope of practice. Dental therapists (under collaborative management agreement) may dispense and administer analgesics, anti-inflammatories, and antibiotics, but are prohibited from dispensing narcotic drugs.
drug_authority.quote: A licensed dental therapist may dispense and administer the following drugs within the parameters of the collaborative management agreement and within the scope of practice of the dental therapist: analgesics, anti-inflammatories, and antibiotics.

value: general anesthesia
moderate sedation
contracted sedation provider
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: for both a general anesthesia and moderate sedation application, $400; for a general anesthesia application only, $400; for a moderate sedation application only, $400; and for a contracted sedation provider application, $400

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: An on-site inspection fee must be paid to the individual, organization, or agency conducting the inspection and be limited to a maximum fee as determined by the board.

specialist_license_available.quote: The board may grant one or more specialty licenses in the specialty areas of dentistry that are recognized by the Commission on Dental Accreditation.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: A specialty dentist holding one or more specialty licenses is limited to practicing in the dentist's designated specialty area or areas.

value: indirect supervision (general supervision under collaborative agreement)
direct supervision
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: All services shall be provided under supervision of a licensed dentist.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: a dental hygienist licensed under this chapter may be employed or retained by a health care facility, program, nonprofit organization, or licensed dentist to perform the dental hygiene services listed in Minnesota Rules, part 3100.8700, subpart 1, without the patient first being examined by a licensed dentist if the dental hygienist: (1) has entered into a collaborative agreement with a licensed dentist

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A collaborating dentist must be licensed under this chapter and may enter into a collaborative agreement with no more than four dental hygienists unless otherwise authorized by the board.

advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: a 'health care facility, program, or nonprofit organization' includes a hospital; nursing home; home health agency; group home serving the elderly, disabled, or juveniles; state-operated facility licensed by the commissioner of human services or the commissioner of corrections; a state-agency-administered public health program or event; and federal, state, or local public health facility, community clinic, tribal clinic, school authority, Head Start program, or nonprofit organization that serves individuals who are uninsured or who are Minnesota health care public program recipients

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: "Dental therapist" means a person licensed under this chapter to perform the services authorized under section 150A.105 or any other services authorized under this chapter.

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: Prior to performing any of the services authorized under this chapter, a dental therapist must enter into a written collaborative management agreement with a Minnesota-licensed dentist.

value: settings that serve low-income, uninsured, and underserved patients
dental health professional shortage areas
dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: A dental therapist licensed under this chapter is limited to primarily practicing in settings that serve low-income, uninsured, and underserved patients or in a dental health professional shortage area.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No corporation shall practice dentistry or engage in it, or hold itself out as being entitled to practice dentistry, or furnish dental services or dentists

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Every licensed dentist and dental therapist who uses the services of any unlicensed person, other than under the dentist's or dental therapist's supervision and within the same practice setting, for the purpose of constructing, altering, repairing or duplicating any denture, partial denture, crown, bridge, splint, orthodontic, prosthetic or other dental appliance, shall be required to furnish such unlicensed person with a written work order

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper and lower denture and removable dental prosthesis fabricated by a dentist licensed under section 150A.06, or fabricated pursuant to the dentist's or dental therapist's work order, shall be marked with the name and Social Security number of the patient for whom the prosthesis is intended.

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: Notwithstanding subdivisions 1, 1a, and 2, a licensed dental hygienist or licensed dental assistant may perform the following restorative procedures: (1) place, contour, and adjust amalgam restorations; (2) place, contour, and adjust glass ionomer; (3) adapt and cement stainless steel crowns; and (4) place, contour, and adjust class I, II, and V supragingival composite restorations on primary and permanent dentition.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: a duplicate copy to be retained in a permanent file of the dentist or dental therapist at the practice setting for a period of two years

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: provide documentation of current CPR certification from completion of the American Heart Association healthcare provider course or the American Red Cross professional rescuer course
